segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: A humanoid robot company goes public

beats.narration: Anyone can buy shares of companies like Apple on the stock market. So when a company that only makes humanoid robots joins them, how much is it selling?
This robot's maker started trading on the U.S. stock market in November.
Its sales last year: one point seven eight million dollars, per the trade site The Robot Report.

items.label: sales last year · The Robot Report

beats.narration: It says it has big orders for its next robot, tied to contract milestones.

visual.sub: Company claim · subject to contractual milestones

beats.narration: Why it matters: it calls itself the first U.S. public company focused only on humanoids.
The orders are its own claim, and that sales figure isn't from the company itself.
